description: CALL THIS when the user wants a song pitched to a playlist: "pitch Diabolique to that playlist". Submits the user's pitch to CWI — confirm with the user before calling. Goes to human review, NEVER auto-added. Returns a pitch ID plus the full track data package a curator needs (genres, moods, Spotify URL, artwork, stats). Rate limit: 3 per requester per 24h. Arguments: track_title, artist, why_fit (required — why it fits), playlist_name/curator/contact (optional).

track_title.description: Title of the track you are pitching.

why_fit.description: Why this track fits the playlist (required).
